page.layout: One page of text, no margin notes. Running head at the top with the page number at the top right. Below it: a major heading, a second heading with a sub-heading, and two poems in verse.

main_text.l: IN TH. B. PSALMOS.
Multa tibi varias peperere poemata Lauros,
Ausonio & patrio, Beza, sonata pede,
Quæ præsens veniensque olim mirabitur ætas,
Æternumque ferent docta per ora decus.
Sed magis ista recens clara tibi frontis honorem
Auxerit, auspicio nam meliore fata est.
QVVM DECVMBERET EX
morbo, 12. April. 1586.
Ad Christum precatio.
Infestus primos qui perdidit ante parentes,
Serpens tergeminis me petit usque dolis,
Ut metus ex animo Supremi Numinis, eheu!
Effluat, & tuta relligionis amor.
Obicit illecebras, fluxa ludibria vitæ, Et mundi vanis, fallit imaginibus.
Si quæ aduersa premunt, si rerum cogit egestas,
Aude, ait: & quicquam turpe putare vetat.
Protinus insano vexat præcordia fastu,
Ut mala me miserum distrahat Ambitio.
Contrà oppono pium cœlo bona vera manere,
Qui nullo quicquam tempore turpe facit.

page.notes: The printed initial "M" of the first poem and "I" of the second are large woodcut-style initials, joined to their first words. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. The second poem's line breaks follow the print; the printed stanza division is not clearly marked, so the lines are kept as one paragraph. The heading "QVVM DECVMBERET EX morbo, 12. April. 1586." is set as a title above a passage and is given level 2 with no caput number.
